chapter_title_en: Rising Wind Overseas, A Nameless Land
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Chapter 588 - Rising Wind Overseas & The Nameless Land
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and his companion emerge from a strange portal into a deadly, pitch-black world. They face Yin Beasts, a blood-soaked desert, and a new tribe of armed survivors who are all too familiar with the local horrors.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Chapter 588
og_description: Han Li escapes one prison only to land in a nameless land of black sand and deadly Yin Beasts.
twitter_description: New world, new rules. Han Li faces a savage frontier.

lore_anchors.definition: A category of monster born from concentrated yin energy or corrupted environments. This term signals a unique, dangerous ecosystem different from common spirit beasts.
A specific type of Yin Beast, described as a leopard-headed monster with crimson scales and razor-sharp fangs. The locals know their behavior patterns.
A traditional Chinese unit of length, approximately 3.33 meters. Used here to describe the size of the cavern and the beasts.
